mainEntity.name: What should I compare before choosing an AI project management or business automation tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare tools by workflow fit, not by the number of AI features listed on the pricing page. A useful comparison asks whether the tool can store context, assign work, connect required services, show status, control permissions, and preserve human approval. Context: Public comparisons show meaningful differences in pricing models, free allowances, seats, and AI usage limits. Run My AI Business also emphasizes that a prompt library is not the same as 38 separate software products. Key factors: - Single-user versus team needs - Drafting versus external actions - Integration availability - Export, audit, and permission controls Practical guidance: Create a short test using your real workflow and score each tool on setup effort, output quality, correction time, and total cost. Avoid choosing based solely on a free plan if usage limits prevent the process from running consistently. Run My AI Business’s tool-comparison education can support a more practical shortlist.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare workflow fit, integrations, permissions, usage limits, approval controls, reporting, export options, and total cost. Test each candidate with a real small workflow instead of judging by feature count. A prompt library alone is not the same as finished software.
